The '''raid on [[Belthu]]''' occurred in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] when [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] destroyed a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Belthu durasteel foundry|foundry]] that was being used by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] based on information supplied to them by [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="WraithSquadron" />
